faq.q: What is the best time for a sunset proposal cruise in Marbella?
faq.a: The golden hour varies by season. In summer (June–August), aim for 20:30–21:30. In spring/autumn (March–May, September–October), 19:30–20:30 works best. Winter (November–February) offers earlier sunsets around 18:30–19:30. We recommend a 2-hour charter starting 30 minutes before sunset to enjoy the changing colours over La Concha mountain.

faq.q: Which boat is best for a romantic proposal in 2027?
faq.a: For an intimate proposal, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) at €749/2h are ideal. For a grand gesture, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) at €4,719/4h includes a free jet ski for a dramatic entrance. All boats depart from Puerto Banús and include a skipper, drinks, and snacks.

faq.q: Can I bring my own decorations or photographer?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring flowers, balloons, or banners. We can also arrange a professional photographer for an additional fee – just let us know via WhatsApp when booking. The skipper will help position the boat for the best sunset photos along the Marbella coastline.

faq.q: What is included in the sunset cruise package?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). The Mangusta 80 also includes a free jet ski. You just need to bring your partner and the ring.

faq.q: How do I propose on a boat without it being awkward?
faq.a: Our skippers are discreet and can create a private moment – they'll anchor at a quiet spot like Cala del Faro or off the Golden Mile. You can also request a specific song to be played. The key is to relax; the sunset does the magic. Many guests pop the question as the sun dips behind La Concha.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on my proposal day?
faq.a: We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe (strong winds or storms), we'll reschedule your charter at no extra cost. For light drizzle or clouds, the cruise still goes ahead – the sunset can still be stunning. We recommend booking a flexible date if you're visiting for a short trip.

faq.q: Can I book a sunset cruise for a group proposal?
faq.a: Absolutely. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) or Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) are great for involving family or friends. You can arrange for them to hide below deck and emerge after the 'yes'. Prices for larger boats are available on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book my proposal cruise?
faq.a: For peak season (June–September), book at least 2–3 weeks ahead to secure your preferred boat and time. For other months, 1 week is usually enough. Last-minute bookings (48 hours) are possible if availability allows – contact us via WhatsApp to check.

Planning a marbella sunset cruise romantic proposal 2027? You're in the right place. With our fleet departing from Puerto Banús, you can pop the question against a backdrop of golden light, the Mediterranean Sea, and the Sierra Blanca mountains. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, including a skipper, drinks, and snacks. Whether you want an intimate moment for two or a celebration with friends, we'll help you craft an unforgettable evening.

Why Choose a Sunset Cruise for Your Proposal?

A sunset cruise offers privacy, natural beauty, and a built-in romantic setting – no crowded restaurant, no awkward timing. The changing colours over the water create a magical atmosphere that photographs beautifully. Plus, you control the moment: anchor at a secluded cove, drop to one knee on the bow, and hear 'yes' with the sound of waves. In 2027, Marbella remains one of Europe's top proposal destinations, with consistent weather and stunning coastlines.

Our Fleet for Your 2027 Proposal

We offer a range of boats to suit different styles and budgets. All depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%).

Best Sunset Spots Along the Marbella Coast

Our skippers know the prime locations for sunset views. Popular anchor points include Cala del Faro (a quiet bay near Cabopino), Cala Cortés (sheltered with golden light), and the stretch off the Golden Mile where La Concha mountain frames the sun. For a longer cruise, head toward Estepona or Sotogrande – the extra distance adds drama and fewer boats in sight.

How to Plan Your 2027 Proposal Step by Step

  1. Choose your boat – consider guest count and vibe. For two, the Astondoa 40 is ideal. For a group, the Azimut 58 Flybridge works well.
  2. Pick a date and time – check sunset times for your month. Summer sunsets are later (20:30–21:30). Book 2–3 weeks ahead in peak season.
  3. Add personal touches – bring flowers, a ring box, and a playlist. We can arrange a photographer for an extra fee.
  4. Coordinate with the skipper – let us know you're proposing. The skipper will anchor at a scenic spot and give you privacy.
  5. Celebrate – after the 'yes', enjoy cava and snacks as the stars come out.

What to Expect on the Day

You'll meet at our base in Puerto Banús (parking available nearby). The skipper will welcome you aboard, brief you on safety, and set off. During the cruise, you can relax on the bow, sip a drink, and watch the coastline. As sunset approaches, the skipper will position the boat for the best view. After the proposal, you can continue cruising or head back to port. The total experience is seamless – you just focus on the moment.
